shortlist.source: Food waste dataset: secondary school in Finland 2024-2025
shortlist.limit: Finnish school waste and diners are not incoming donation offers.

shortlist.source: Food Waste Dataset from a University Canteen
shortlist.limit: Canteen disposal by category describes a different outcome from offered edible weight.
Weighed meal images do not establish donation weights, storage or eligibility.

shortlist.source: Fruit and Vegetable Disease (Healthy vs Rotten)
shortlist.limit: A visual quality label cannot establish microbiological safety or storage history.
Category-labelled grocery images need a reviewed model and a holdout before scoring.
Product metadata does not establish eligibility. Barcode lookup is separate from intake.
The prototype uses operator review. Model windows are explicitly synthetic.

shortlist.source: StatCan — Monthly average retail prices for selected products (18-10-0245-01)
shortlist.limit: Matched PEI item, period and units or kitchen invoice required. App CAD uses illustrative inputs.
Food-bank visits do not measure the demand or intake capacity at a receiving kitchen.
Product footprints are not avoided PEI treatment emissions without a defined comparison.

shortlist.source: ECCC Greenhouse Gas Calculator for Organic Waste Management
shortlist.limit: Use for a documented treatment scenario. No default coefficient was applied.

shortlist.source: IWMC 'Sort It Out' waste sorting guide
shortlist.limit: A landfill default can misstate the comparison under PEI's separate compost collection.

shortlist.source: PEI Food Recovery Network — Final Report
shortlist.limit: Historical signups size the reference case. Chart 1 sets expected offer mix in a synthetic scenario.
Documented matching tools provide a comparison. No private offer data was imported.
Directory locations do not establish capacity or receiving consent.

shortlist.source: Canadian Business Counts, with employees, CMAs and census subdivisions (33-10-1097-01)
shortlist.limit: Only an eligible and reachable subset would represent potential customers.
The demo uses a schematic, approximate town centres and straight-line distance.
No redistribution or automatic recipe approval. The demo uses five authored meal entries.
